rule: Only recently changed targets: finish ordinary budget, reach 12 saturated 16ms age ticks, then deliver at most 2 or 4 extra strong pulses per stable interval. Any target change cancels the old wait/tail. No optical residual detection.
age_quantization: Eligibility at approximately177..192ms of sampled-target stability, then wait for an available scan; normal budget completion also required.
counter_units: stable_tail_pulses counts successful additional pixel-pulses, not scan activations; ordinary pulses and maintenance are excluded.
test_scope: Baseline used existing v7 firmware; candidate v8. All six planner test suites pass, including default-off equivalence and stable-tail preview/commit checks. Both firmware environments build. Timed clips use first16s of the same embedded45fps full video.
excluded_trial: Initial cold-boot run still used FR2,7/7,fullRAM,pipelineoff and was excluded; proper profile was restored before the baseline recorded here.
